scope: Downloaded primary research papers, inspected full texts and sections; no local effectiveness reproduction.

papers.title: PRADA: Protecting against DNN Model Stealing Attacks
papers.inspected_sections: Methods Section V-A (pp. 10-12), mitigation and Sybil discussion (pp. 13-14).
papers.caveat: DNN classifier extraction setting; does not establish protection for general LLM traffic.

papers.title: Stateful Detection of Model Extraction Attacks
papers.status: arXiv preprint; no peer-reviewed venue verified
papers.inspected_sections: Threat model, VAE/MMD algorithm, Section 7.3 adaptive attacks (pp. 8-10), including explicit 5% dilution miss.
papers.caveat: Its reported dilution miss is specific to the evaluated classifier setting.

papers.title: An Embarrassingly Simple Detector for Model Extraction Attacks in Large Language Model API Traffic
papers.inspected_sections: Methods Sections 2-3; experiment settings 4.1; adaptive and contamination analyses 4.5-4.6; limitations; original-protocol comparison 4.7; relevant full PDF text and arXiv HTML inspected.
papers.caveat: Reported error rates are offline window results, not online pre-transfer stopping guarantees.

papers.title: Nonparametric Two-Sample Testing by Betting
papers.status: IEEE Transactions on Information Theory 2023 work; downloaded later arXiv v6 correction
papers.inspected_sections: Sections 1.1, 2.1, conditional-expectation assumptions, pair symmetry Remark, Section 5.1. Latest revision fixes theorem proof; theorem applicability not assumed for raw conversational traffic.
papers.caveat: Conditional fair-bet assumptions require justification; raw dependent chat windows do not inherit the theorem.

papers.title: Retrain or not retrain: conformal test martingales for change-point detection
papers.inspected_sections: Section 2 definitions, randomized sequential rank p-values, exchangeability assumptions, Proposition 1, Ville inequality (pp. 2-4), calibration example (p. 5).
papers.caveat: Exchangeability applies to the ranked units; arbitrary overlapping chat windows are not automatically valid units.

papers.title: Antidistillation Sampling
papers.status: Downloaded arXiv preprint; peer-reviewed venue not established in this review
papers.inspected_sections: Algorithm 1; Section 4.1; proxy-gradient and decoding-cost discussion.
papers.caveat: Needs proxy computation and local logits; adaptive learners can exploit preserved reasoning.

papers.title: DOGe: Defensive Output Generation for LLM Protection Against Knowledge Distillation
papers.status: Downloaded arXiv preprint; peer-reviewed venue not established in this review
papers.inspected_sections: Section 3 and Figure 2; defensive final-head training objective.
papers.caveat: Requires teacher-head training and a proxy; not a gateway-only output filter.

papers.title: Protecting Language Models Against Unauthorized Distillation through Trace Rewriting
papers.status: Downloaded arXiv preprint; peer-reviewed venue not established in this review
papers.inspected_sections: Sections 5.1, 6.4; Appendices A.2, B, D.2, E.3, especially Table 5.
papers.caveat: Small 7B self-rewriter result is math-specific; main setup uses a much larger rewriter; human explanation utility unproven.

papers.title: Lossless Anti-Distillation Sampling
papers.status: Downloaded arXiv preprint; peer-reviewed venue not established in this review
papers.caveat: Targets aligned redundant sampling; theorem is an upper bound, and Table 2 disagrees with a nearby numerical prose claim.

papers.title: DistillGuard: Evaluating Defenses Against LLM Knowledge Distillation
papers.status: Downloaded arXiv preprint; peer-reviewed venue not established in this review
papers.inspected_sections: Abstract, threat model and defense comparison experiments.
papers.caveat: Reported effects depend on task and naive-attacker recipe; removing reasoning does not reliably protect code.

papers.title: Watermark Basins: Black-Box Detection of Distilled LLMs
papers.status: Downloaded arXiv preprint; peer-reviewed venue not established in this review
papers.inspected_sections: Section 3; Appendix B.4 on reference-bank and audit costs.
papers.caveat: Post-training attribution requiring suspect outputs, not prevention of collection.

papers.title: Can LLM Watermarks Robustly Prevent Unauthorized Knowledge Distillation?
papers.status: Downloaded arXiv preprint; peer-reviewed venue not established in this review
papers.inspected_sections: Methods and experiments on preprocessing and inference-time neutralization.
papers.caveat: Watermark evidence and actual capability transfer are separate outcomes.

papers.title: On the Learnability of Antidistillation Reasoning Traces
papers.inspected_sections: Sections 3–5; Appendix Tables 4–6, including OCR reconstruction.
papers.caveat: Unicode defenses impair machine-readable utility and face rendering/OCR recovery.

papers.title: Let Them Steal: Trapping Large Language Model Extraction Attacks with Knowledge Honeypot
papers.status: Downloaded arXiv v1; EMNLP 2026 Main acceptance reported by authors department
papers.caveat: Applies to response-guided entity expansion; fixed-corpus collection need not follow the bait.

papers.title: The False Promise of Imitating Proprietary LLMs
papers.status: Downloaded arXiv preprint; peer-reviewed venue not established in this review
papers.caveat: Older model/data findings; not proof that current task-specific distillation fails.

papers.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
papers.status: Downloaded arXiv preprint; peer-reviewed venue not established in this review
papers.inspected_sections: Full text; introduction, method and limitations.
papers.caveat: Memory-saving technique; reported hardware results do not certify this GPU or training recipe.

papers.title: s1: Simple test-time scaling
papers.status: Downloaded arXiv preprint; peer-reviewed venue not established in this review
papers.caveat: Sample efficiency does not imply the 32B and multi-H100 training recipe fits this machine.

papers.title: Do Defenses Against LLM Extraction Work Across Attacks? A Lifecycle Benchmark of Black-Box Model Extraction
papers.status: Downloaded arXiv preprint; peer-reviewed venue not established in this review
papers.inspected_sections: Sections 2–4; Appendices B, D, E, especially E.4.
papers.caveat: Preprint, narrow evaluated models/tasks and 20 attack batches per method; no reproduction here.
